# Answer key: two-currency-letter.txt

## Prayer requests (expected)
- Visa renewal appointment / smooth paperwork process (Situational)

## One-time needs (expected)
- Heating system replacement, **$2,100** (not 8,400 zloty), no firm deadline
  beyond "before winter" -- background should mention the heating system
  failed inspection.

## What this fixture tests
Unlike the Hartwell letter (local-currency figure and USD figure in
different paragraphs), both amounts appear in the *same sentence* right
next to the ask -- confirms the model picks the USD figure specifically
and doesn't average, sum, or default to whichever number comes first.
